content.text: [2026-10-22 08:10:23+08:00] [experiment]: 读取scratch/users.json，将enabled=true的用户名按字典序写入scratch/enabled.json数组；同时生成scratch/manifest.json，只含file='enabled.json'与count两个字段，count必须等于数组长度。 所有输入文件必须保持原样。输出文件使用UTF-8，完成后简短说明。

arguments.label: Inspect users.json
arguments.command: cd task/scratch 2>/dev/null || cd scratch; pwd; ls -la; echo ---; cat users.json

cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task/scratch
md5 users.json > /tmp/before.md5
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
users=json.load(open('users.json',encoding='utf-8'))
names=sorted(u['name'] for u in users if u.get('enabled') is True)
json.dump(names,open('enabled.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
json.dump({"file":"enabled.json","count":len(names)},open('manifest.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
EOF
md5 -c /tmp/before.md5 2>/dev/null || md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5
echo ---; cat enabled.json; echo; cat manifest.json; echo; file enabled.json manifest.json
